# The Singapore Women's Weekly

> > Singapore's leading women's lifestyle magazine covering wellness, beauty, food, family, travel, and celebrity news.

The Singapore Women's Weekly is a trusted source for Singaporean women seeking expert advice on spa treatments, dining experiences, parenting tips, and lifestyle trends. The publication is renowned for its annual Spa Awards recognizing excellence in aesthetic and wellness treatments across Singapore.

## Key Topics

- Spa Awards 2025
- Singapore wellness and beauty
- Medi-facials and aesthetic treatments
- Tui Na and body massages
- IDS Aesthetics
- Glamour Plus
- BMF Aesthetics
- Family travel and parenting
- Singapore food guides
- Batam travel and dining
- High tea promotions
- Ramadan Bazaar
- Celebrity news and entertainment
- Japan travel destinations
- Weekend getaways

## Spa & Wellness Awards

- [The Singapore Women's Weekly Spa Awards 2025 Winners](https://www.womensweekly.com.sg/topics/spa-awards-2025): Spa Awards 2025 winners featuring IDS Aesthetics, Glamour Plus, BMF
- [Best Overall Tui Na Experience To Relieve Body Aches And Pains](https://www.womensweekly.com.sg/your-life/best-overall-tui-na-experience-st-gregory-spa-pan-pacific-singapore): St. Gregory Spa at Pan Pacific Singapore wins best Tui Na treatment

## Food & Dining

- [Top Foodie Picks At Kampong Gelam Ramadan Bazaar 2025](https://www.womensweekly.com.sg/food/kampong-gelam-ramadan-bazaar): Kampong Gelam Ramadan Bazaar 2025 food guide with 120+ stalls
- [Best 1-For-1 High Tea Buffet Promotions & Deals In Singapore](https://www.womensweekly.com.sg/food/1-for-1-high-tea-deals-promos-singapore): Singapore high tea 1-for-1 deals at Marriott, Holiday Inn & more
